sloka: सम्प्रदास्यामि रामाया यथा सिद्धिम् तपस्विने ।स मुहूर्तम् इव ध्यात्वा चिन्ता विग्रथित इन्द्रियः ॥५-१३-५८॥
transliteration: sampradāsyāmi rāmāyā yathā siddhim tapasvine ।sa muhūrtam iva dhyātvā cintā vigrathita indriyaḥ ॥5-13-58॥

translations.english: The brilliant son of the Windgod, Hanuman, whose senses were overwhelmed with worries, regained his senses in a short while and got up.
